Name: Intercept
Description: Takes damage in place of the defending unit. If two or more units with Intercept are present, the leftmost becomes the defending unit.

Name: Final Wager
Description: Triggers an effect when the unit dies.

Name: Obscured
Description: If face-down during Bet Phase, triggers an effect when combat starts.

Name: Combat Start
Description: Triggers an effect at the start of combat.

Name: Cleave
Description: Damages the defending unit and all units directly to its left and right.

Name: Advantage
Description: Triggers an effect when an ally attacks.

Name: On Use
Description: Instead of Attacking the defending target, triggers the On Use effect.
